title: Canonical finite open exchange with restricted completed scalar action
statement: For an adic datum $d$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum] and an open Cartesian square $(v,j',j,g)$ [def-cbc-open-immersion-square], use the finite constant-ring source and target composites, finite coefficient restrictions and derived reductions of [def-cbc-completed-finite-exchange-coordinates]. At $n\in\mathbf N$ put $B_n=A/I^{n+1}$. Define cbcFiniteInverse to be the inverse finite open exchange, the open-unit adjunct $j'_!v^*\to g^*j_!$, whiskered on the right by scalar restriction from $B_n$ to the completed coefficient ring. Its inverse exists by Cartesian open base change. Define cbcFiniteExchange as the inverse of its exact derived natural isomorphism. Thus it is a fixed map with its completed scalar action, not an arbitrary isomorphism of finite endpoints.
